---
name: app-review
description: Review app changes for correctness, UX, performance, and testing gaps. Trigger keywords: app review, react-native review, mobile review.
---

## Review Focus
- UI correctness and edge cases
- Accessibility and keyboard navigation
- State and data consistency
- Performance and render risks
- Missing tests and validation gaps

## Output
- A concise list of findings ordered by severity.
- Notes on missing tests or monitoring.
- Recommendation to approve or request changes.
